subject.title: fix(tts): contract speech requests hang on stalled endpoints

question: Should the earlier exact-head automerge authorization for `f8f30becf2e9` be renewed for the force-pushed head `8fc0b5e8706` after its failing contracts check is resolved?

options.title: Refresh proof and approval

options.title: Decline the new head
options.body: Keep the PR in human review if the force-push materially changes the reviewed timeout implementation or no longer warrants the prior approval.

recommendation.title: Refresh proof and approval
